meta.name: qa
meta.description: Interactive QA session where user reports bugs or issues conversationally, and the agent files GitHub issues. Explores the codebase in the background for context and domain language. Use when user wants to report bugs, do QA, file issues conversationally, or mentions "QA session".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用对话方式提交 GitHub issue
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望用聊天方式记录和提交代码缺陷。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to report bugs and file issues via chat.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你以对话方式描述软件问题，然后自动在 GitHub 上创建问题报告。它会先了解代码库背景，确保报告使用项目术语，但不暴露内部代码细节。
howto.when: 当你提到“QA session”、想报告 bug、或要求以对话方式提交 GitHub issue 时触发。

say.text: 我们来开一个 QA session，我遇到了一个 bug。
say.note: 启动交互式 QA 会话。

say.text: 提交一个 issue：点击保存按钮后页面没有反应。
say.note: 直接描述问题，Claude 会帮你创建 issue。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you to describe software problems conversationally and automatically create GitHub issues. It explores the codebase for context to write issues using project domain language without exposing internal code details.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "QA session", want to report a bug, or ask to file a GitHub issue conversationally.

say_en.text: Let's start a QA session, I found a bug.
File an issue: clicking the save button does nothing.
say_en.note: Describes the problem directly; Claude will create the issue.
